{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check that revenue is string and has thousands separators
print(f"Revenue dtype after filtering: {completed_orders['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"Sample revenue values after filtering: {completed_orders['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any remaining QA orders in completed orders
qa_in_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
print(f"QA orders in completed orders: {len(qa_in_completed)}")

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
